instruction: Complete the work through the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools: update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a compact single-room modern office shell with a flat floor slab, one entrance door, and one side window. The owner wants this early concept model prepared for a small automation office handover package: the ground level, room, perimeter walls, and floor should read as intentional architectural elements rather than generic placeholders. Keep the existing room shell, door, window, openings, and containment relationships intact. Use a simple office wall build-up with brick and gypsum board, a concrete floor slab assembly, and record the change with revision code BONSAI-CLI-01 so downstream QA can identify the updated room, walls, and assemblies.
